audit.why: Both layers already read Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Lucian / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen, which matches the packet chart and the mirror exactly. phases[N].side and win[N] agree row for row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice on the whole matchup, and it is right — not one number appears anywhere.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Snip Snip! 6.5s down to 3.5s, Skip 'n Slash 13s with a partial refund whenever she hits something, Needlework 120/100/80s. 'Commit on Hallowed Mist's cooldown' means nothing without the 22s, and Skip 'n Slash's refund is why she is rarely caught without a dash.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every mention of Hallowed Mist says 'untargetable — never burn damage into it', which is half the mechanic and produces the wrong play.
audit.why: Riot's text: she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist. She is not untargetable, she is untargetable from outside. The counterplay is to walk into the cloud, which no field says. A reader told only 'never ult into mist' will stand outside and give her a free 22-second reset every time.
audit.corrected: The step-inside rule written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said only 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' with no reason and the wrong pronoun.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her for a portion of the bonus magic damage dealt to champions — that is the sustain, and it scales off YOUR health bar, not hers. Skip 'n Slash also grants magic on-hit, so armour alone misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names A Thousand Cuts as the reason for the Grievous Wounds buy.

edits.before: Track Gwen’s Hallowed Mist: Untargetable from outside the mist — never burn damage into it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist (22s at rank 1): she is targetable only from INSIDE it — step into the cloud to hit her, or wait the whole 22s out.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — Untargetable from outside the mist — never burn damage into it. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, and she is targetable only from inside it: walk in or wait it out. - Skip 'n Slash is 13s and refunds on hit, so it is rarely down. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Untargetable from outside the mist — never burn damage into it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Targetable only from inside the mist — step in to hit her, or hold. Its 22s downtime is your green light.

edits.before: The Culling whiffs into W Hallowed Mist — she goes untargetable and snips you with Q true damage, so her level 6 outclasses yours.
edits.after: The Culling whiffs into Hallowed Mist unless you stand inside it — she snips true damage on a 6.5s Q while your 110s ult burns.

edits.before: The Culling does nothing if she pops W Hallowed Mist — your ult and her untargetability mist both come online and hers wins the exchange.
edits.after: The Culling does nothing into Hallowed Mist unless you step inside the cloud — a 22s W should never be allowed to eat your 110s R.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you're still ahead — keep forcing short trades with E-resets and W speed before her items land. But respect Level 6: The Culling is near-useless into Gwen because she just pops W Hallowed Mist and your whole channel hits nothing while she's untargetable and snipping you with Q true damage. Don't ult into mist. This is your last real window — if you haven't built a lead by now, you're about to lose the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you're still ahead — keep forcing short trades with E-resets and W speed before her items land. But respect Level 6: Hallowed Mist makes her targetable only from inside the cloud, so The Culling hits nothing while you stand outside snipped by her true damage. Step into the mist or don't ult at all — a 22s W should never eat your 110s R. This is your last real window before the lane turns.

edits.before: Use W Ardent Blaze move-speed to kite her E dash and keep her out of Q true-damage range
edits.after: Attack the Ardent Blaze mark for the move speed, then kite Skip 'n Slash out of Snip Snip! range

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori by lane state. Grievous Wounds early — A Thousand Cuts heals her off your HP bar.

notes: The chart was already correct here and matches the mirror — no flips needed. The substantive find is Hallowed Mist: the page called her untargetable when she is targetable from inside the cloud, which turns 'never ult into mist' from a rule into a solvable problem. The packet's 'no cooldown sequencing anywhere' defect is now addressed with the 22s mist, 6.5s Q and 13s refunding E. Note the full layer refers to Gwen as 'he/him' in several template-derived fields (dontsFull[1].t, breakdown.feeding); those are champion-agnostic boilerplate rather than matchup facts and I left them, but they should be swept champion-wide.
